acceptance.given: During Package A production delivery, the validator policy artifact is declared at scripts/sc/config/skill-authoring-standard.v1.json and the validator implementation is available to consume it.

oracle.expected: A validator invocation loads scripts/sc/config/skill-authoring-standard.v1.json successfully and proceeds using that versioned policy, with no missing-artifact diagnostic.
forbidden: The declared policy artifact is absent.
oracle.observable: The validator's structured result or load check identifies scripts/sc/config/skill-authoring-standard.v1.json as the loaded policy and does not report it missing.

acceptance.then: The versioned policy artifact exists at scripts/sc/config/skill-authoring-standard.v1.json and is usable by the validator.
acceptance.when: Run the repository's policy-loading validator check in the unit verification lane against the declared policy path.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A unit test or validator load check targeting scripts/sc/config/skill-authoring-standard.v1.json must fail with an AssertionError when the declared policy file is absent or cannot be loaded.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Deliver the versioned skill-authoring policy JSON at the declared path and make it loadable as the validator's policy input.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Removing the new policy artifact restores the pre-delivery state; no database or persistent schema migration is involved.

slice_hint.state_transition: Policy deliverable moves from not established to present and loadable by the validator.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator policy-loading check completes without a missing-policy diagnostic and confirms the declared artifact path is the loaded policy.
